deadline.value: December 1 application deadline for annual review
deadline.quote: We review applications for admission to our Graduate Program one time each year. The application deadline is December 1

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer required for admission into the graduate program for the Biology department.
gre_general.quote: UPDATE: The GRE is no longer required for admission into the graduate program for the Biology department

gre_subject.value: The GRE subject test in Biology is not required for application to our program.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE subject test in Biology is not required for application to our program.

supervisor.value: Supervisor contact prior to application is not stated as required.

funding.value: Admitted students are supported through graduate assistantships with stipend and tuition waiver.
funding.quote: Most entering graduate students are initially supported by a teaching assistantship, which pays the student’s tuition and provides a stipend.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from bachelor's degree with upper-division GPA of at least 3.0.
entry_route.quote: For applicants with solely a bachelor’s degree, a minimum 3.0 GPA on all coursework completed after the applicant has earned 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) is required.
